Not only is there no graveyard, there's no such thing as a krayt or a pearl. All that you'll find out there are some giant sand beetles that will be more than happy to make a meal out of you.|Patrons in a Tatooine cantina|<ref name="PitS">{{InsiderCite|74|Pearls in the Sand}}</ref>}}
'''Sand beetles''' were a type of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" /> Giant sand beetles were rumored to attack and eat imprudent travelers in the [[Krayt Graveyard]].<ref name="PitS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IDontThinkThisIsADroch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tatooine "mite" concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Sand beetles appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sand beetles were almost identical to [[Rockmite/Legends|rockmites]], [[rock beetle]]s, [[cave beetle]]s and [[Dune beetle/Legends|dune beetles]], using the same base model with different textures.<ref name="SWG" />
